verifications.claim: Lontrell Williams Sr. is the father of rapper Pooh Shiesty.

verifications.claim: Lontrell Williams Sr. is known as "Mob Boss".

verifications.claim: Lontrell Williams Sr. was arrested in April 2026 alongside his son by the FBI.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "Shiesty was arrested in Texas... Shiesty’s father, Lontrell Denell Williams Sr., had been arrested in Tennessee" (R4); "one of the suspects was taken into custody in Frisco, Texas, whereas the other suspects were apprehended in Memphis" (R1); arrests on April 1/2, 2026 (multiple)
verifications.reasoning: Arrests occurred in April 2026 by FBI, but father in Memphis home raid and son separately in Dallas/Texas, not 'alongside' (together).

verifications.claim: Lontrell Williams Sr. and his son are accused of masterminding a federal kidnapping and armed robbery targeting rapper Gucci Mane.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS

verifications.reasoning: Sources agree on accusations of kidnapping/robbery targeting Gucci Mane, son as ringleader, but father 'assisted' (most sources) vs. 'masterminding' (R5), creating contradiction.
